- No recourse: judiciary doesn't function as protection avenue; no anti-discrimination law; no hate-crime enhancement. Rule 11: rule of law not working; no recourse at all. Rule 21: no documented remedy.

- No border/entry documentation issues recorded — but that's silence, not safety, in a thin-data state.
- No criminalisation of gender expression documented.
- No facility bans, no custody rule documented, no organised targeting/police sweeps documented.
